source.note: On the chest (på brystet). The club's renewal announcement (12 Aug 2024) extends Lyse's main-sponsor deal by three years from 2025.
source.quote: det er stor stolthet knyttet til at Viking-spillerne har Lyse på brystet

source.name: Viking: Viking har Eliteseriens fineste drakt 2026
source.note: Kit maker: the club names Diadora as the maker of its 2026 shirt.
source.quote: Den retroinspirerte drakta fra Diadora baserer seg på klubbens tradisjonelle uttrykk, men med moderne detaljer

summary: Lyse, owned by 15 Norwegian municipalities, is on the front of Viking's Diadora-made 2026 home shirt. Not complete: the club's kit launch names no sponsors, and no source found names the other logos on this shirt (OBOS, SpareBank 1 Sør-Norge and Kabal are Viking partners, but their sources don't place them on the 2026 home shirt).
shortLine: Lyse on the front, Diadora kit
